question: Who among the following founded the Ramakrishna Mission to carry on humanitarian and social work?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Vivekananda.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ramakrishna Mission was founded by **Swami Vivekananda in 1897.**
 
• He established the mission to propagate the teachings of his spiritual guru, **Sri Ramakrishna**, and to carry on humanitarian, educational, and social work.
 
• The Ramakrishna Mission focuses on:
 
 
• Promoting **Vedantic philosophy.**
 
• Providing education, healthcare, and disaster relief.
 
• Engaging in various social welfare activities, such as running schools, hospitals, and orphanages.
 
 
 
• Swami Vivekananda's vision was to serve humanity selflessly and uplift the masses, combining spiritual development with practical service.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Debendranath Tagore (1817–1905)**

 
 
• He founded the Tattvabodhini Sabha**j**
 
• Social Reformer: Advocated for social justice and educational reforms.
 
• Father of Rabindranath Tagore: Influential in promoting literature and philanthropy.
 
 
 
• **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar (1820–1891)**
 
 
• Social Reformer: Advocated for **widow remarriage and social reforms.**
 
• Educationist: Promoted modern education and Bengali literature.
 
• Philanthropist: Improved educational and social conditions in Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Aurobindo Ghosh (1872–1950)**
 
 
• Spiritual Leader: Founded Integral Yoga, focusing on spiritual transformation.
 
• Freedom Fighter: Active in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He founded **Sri Aurobindo Ashram**: Center for spiritual practice and teachings.
